summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist in monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py, exported it from monai/data/__init__.py, added the "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and wrote tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Tests and black were not run, per instructions; I only measured that all new lines are within 120 columns. No commits were made.
